hero.title: About Alamer Mall
hero.subtitle: Eastern Province's premier shopping and entertainment destination, serving our community for over a decade

whoWeAre.title: What Drives Us
whoWeAre.description: Alamer Mall is more than just a shopping center – we are a vibrant community hub that brings together retail, dining, entertainment, and lifestyle experiences under one roof. Located in the heart of Al-Ahssa, we pride ourselves on offering a world-class shopping experience that caters to the diverse needs of our community.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide an exceptional shopping and entertainment experience that brings families together and creates lasting memories while supporting local and international businesses.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the premier shopping destination in the Eastern Province, recognized for excellence in retail, dining, and entertainment, while contributing to the community's economic growth.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: Customer satisfaction, quality service, innovation, community engagement, and sustainable growth guide everything we do at Alamer Mall.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.description: Since our establishment, Alamer Mall has been committed to redefining the shopping experience in the Eastern Province. With over 150 stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues, we have become the go-to destination for families, shoppers, and entertainment seekers alike.
ourStory.paragraph1: Located in the heart of Al Mubarraz, Alamer Mall has been a cornerstone of the community. What began as a vision to create a world-class shopping destination has grown into much more – a place where families gather, friendships flourish, and memories are made.
ourStory.paragraph2: Spanning five floors and featuring a diverse mix of stores and dining options, Alamer Mall offers an unparalleled shopping experience. From fashion and electronics to groceries and dining, we provide everything our community needs under one roof.
ourStory.paragraph3: Our commitment goes beyond retail. We actively support local businesses, create employment opportunities, and contribute to the economic development of the Eastern Province. Through regular events, seasonal celebrations, and community initiatives, we strive to be more than just a mall – we aim to be a vital part of the community fabric.

hero.title: Events & Promotions
hero.subtitle: Discover exciting events and exclusive offers

summerSale.title: Summer Sale 2025
summerSale.description: Get ready for the biggest shopping event of the season! Enjoy up to 70% off on selected items across all fashion stores. From luxury brands to everyday essentials, find incredible deals on clothing, accessories, shoes, and more. Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe with the latest trends at unbeatable prices.

kidsFestival.title: Kids Festival
kidsFestival.description: Bring your little ones for a day filled with fun, laughter, and excitement! Our Kids Festival features interactive games, face painting, magic shows, balloon artists, bouncy castles, and special performances. Educational workshops and creative activities will keep children entertained while parents can enjoy shopping. Special prizes and giveaways throughout the day!

foodWeek.title: International Food Week
foodWeek.description: Embark on a culinary journey around the world without leaving Alamer Mall! Experience authentic cuisines from Italy, Japan, India, Mexico, France, and many more countries. Meet celebrity chefs, attend live cooking demonstrations, participate in food tasting sessions, and enjoy special menu items created exclusively for this event. Every day features a different country's cuisine with traditional music and cultural performances.

techExpo.title: Tech & Gaming Expo 2025
techExpo.description: Technology enthusiasts and gamers, this is your event! Explore the latest gadgets, gaming consoles, virtual reality experiences, and cutting-edge electronics. Try out upcoming game releases, compete in esports tournaments with cash prizes, meet gaming influencers, and attend tech talks by industry experts. Exclusive expo discounts on all electronics and gaming accessories!

ramadanMarket.title: Ramadan Night Market
ramadanMarket.description: Experience the magic of Ramadan with our special night market featuring traditional crafts, authentic Middle Eastern cuisine, and live cultural performances. Shop for unique handmade items, enjoy special Iftar offers at participating restaurants, and immerse yourself in the festive atmosphere. Traditional music, henna artists, and family-friendly activities available every evening.

fashionWeek.title: Fashion Week Showcase
fashionWeek.description: Witness the hottest fashion trends of the season on the runway! Local and international designers present their latest collections in a spectacular fashion show. Enjoy exclusive previews of new collections, meet fashion designers, participate in styling workshops, and take advantage of special Fashion Week discounts at all participating boutiques.

blackFriday.title: Black Friday Mega Sale
blackFriday.description: The most anticipated shopping event of the year is here! Massive discounts up to 80% off on everything from electronics to fashion, home goods to beauty products. Early bird specials start at 6 AM with doorbusters and limited quantity items. Extended mall hours, special midnight madness deals, and gift with purchase offers at select stores.

winterWonderland.title: Winter Wonderland Experience
winterWonderland.description: Transform your mall visit into a magical winter adventure! Our Winter Wonderland features a real ice skating rink, snow play area for kids, festive decorations throughout the mall, and photo opportunities with Santa Claus. Enjoy hot chocolate stations, seasonal treats, holiday market stalls with unique gift ideas, and live performances of holiday classics.

healthFair.title: Health & Wellness Fair
healthFair.description: Prioritize your wellbeing at our comprehensive Health & Wellness Fair! Free health screenings, fitness demonstrations, nutrition consultations, yoga and meditation sessions, and wellness workshops throughout the day. Meet health experts, try new fitness classes, sample organic foods, and discover wellness products.

artFestival.title: Art & Culture Festival
artFestival.description: Celebrate creativity and culture at our Art Festival featuring local and regional artists! Browse and purchase original artworks, watch live painting demonstrations, participate in art workshops for all ages, and enjoy cultural performances including traditional dance and music. Interactive installations throughout the mall create an immersive artistic experience.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about visiting Alamer Mall

q1.question: What are the operating hours of Al-Amer Mall?
q1.answer: Al-Amer Mall operates Saturday through Thursday from 6:00 AM to 2:30 AM, and Friday from 9:00-10:30 AM and 1:00 PM to 2:30 AM. Operating hours may vary during seasons and holidays.

q2.question: Is parking available?
q2.answer: Yes, Al-Amer Mall provides spacious and convenient parking facilities for all mall visitors.

q3.question: Is Al-Amer Mall suitable for families?
q3.answer: Absolutely! The mall is designed to be a safe and comfortable destination for all family members.

q4.question: Are there offers and discounts?
q4.answer: Yes, we offer seasonal promotions and ongoing discounts. Follow us on social media to learn about the latest offers.

q5.question: How can I contact the mall management?
q5.answer: You can contact us through the Customer Service page or through the contact information provided on the website.
